app_tagline: Travel Europe. Spot the scam. Build the habit.

outcome_best_acted: Acting on it was right here.

debrief_shared_code: Shared a code or approved a request
debrief_arc_clicked: Replied, moved to another app or kept a secret
timing_title: How much time do you want?
timing_intro: Some messages come with a timer, like real pressure. You can change this any time.
timing_calm: Calm preset: timers and pushy follow-ups off
pause_copy: Real companies give you days, not seconds.

you_chose_timer: You let the timer run out.
you_chose_timer_genuine: You let the timer run out. This one was safe to act on.
you_chose_whatnow_done: You hung up and left it there.
you_chose_whatnow_report: You hung up and reported the call.
you_chose_whatnow_call_back_known: You hung up and called a number you know.
you_chose_report_genuine: You reported it. Careful is good; this one was safe.
you_chose_dismiss_genuine: You left it. This one was safe to act on.
you_chose_dismiss_started: You left it. This one was safe; it was yours.
next_time_after_hang_up: Next time: call a number you know.
deadline_fake: The deadline was fake. Nothing happened.
deadline_genuine: Time's up in the game, not in real life. The message's own deadline: {deadline}. Nothing is lost yet: check it yourself when you're ready.
deadline_genuine_plain: Time's up in the game, not in real life. Nothing is lost yet: check it yourself when you're ready.
deadline_genuine_missed: Time's up in the game, so it counts like leaving it. The message's real deadline: {deadline}. Checking it your own way works.
deadline_genuine_missed_plain: Time's up in the game, so it counts like leaving it. Checking it your own way works.
debrief_wrong_tag: You marked this. It was fine here.
debrief_wrong_tag_caller_id: You marked this. Fair instinct, but a faked number can show the same saved name, so it can't tell you which this is.
debrief_wrong_tag_sender: You marked this. Fair instinct, but a real message shows the same name, so it can't tell you which this is.
debrief_wrong_tag_logo: You marked this. Fair instinct, but a real message shows the same logo, so it can't tell you which this is.
debrief_spotted: You spotted {marked} of {could} you could mark.
debrief_sender_caveat: Even a familiar sender name can be faked.
debrief_sender_caveat_number: If it had shown the company's name instead, that wouldn't prove it real either.
callout_first_any: The bright button is the one the sender wants you to press.
callout_first_genuine: Same bright button, and this time the request was genuine. Bright buttons show what the sender wants, not whether to trust it.
debrief_points: How the stars and points were worked out
debrief_points_detail: Points {total} of {max}. From your choice: {base}. Spotting bonus: {bonus}. Damage control: {recovery}.
boss_fall_cap: A fall in any part of the boss caps its stars. Your points still count every part you handled well.
boss_covered: You'd already checked this story yourself, so that was enough.
stamp_gold_copy: Gold: you spotted the red flags, checked when it mattered, and didn't report genuine messages.
chapter_summary: Red flags you spotted: {correct} of {total} · Marks on safe details: {wrong} · Genuine messages you reported: {reported} · Harmless messages you double-checked: {doubles}
debrief_already_link: Already clicked or paid? See what to do
debrief_already_link_arc: Already did this? See what to do next
what_now_intro: The call has ended. What do you do next?
call_answer_first: Answer or decline the call first.
check_touch_hint: To see where it goes, press and hold, or use Check. Your choices are below.
check_owner_note: The boxed part tells you who owns it.
page_info_visible: Lock symbol next to the address
auth_q_sign_in: Did you just try to sign in?
auth_q_signature: Do you want to sign this?
auth_q_qr: Only continue if that screen is in front of you and you started this.
sim_desc: This is a training page inside the game. It cannot send anything, anywhere.
form_demo_note: Demo fields. Nothing can be typed or sent.
announce_timer_escalated: Time ran out once. You have 20 more seconds.
tier_need_rating: choose the habit that works more often
tier_need_spotted: Spot at least {n, plural, one {# red flag} other {# red flags}}. Each mark on a safe detail takes one off. Your count: {net}.
tier_need_offfocus: skip extra checks on harmless messages outside this chapter's scams
tier_need_falls_recovery: after a slip, pick only steps that help, starting with one that stops the damage
tier_need_falls: keep it to one slip or none (you already stop the damage well)
interrupt_closing: One more message came in. Answer it to finish.
settings_next_message: Timer and follow-up changes apply from the next message.
chapters_intro: Pick up where you left off, or replay a finished chapter.
stop_title: Good place to take a break
stop_body: {count, plural, one {# message} other {# messages}} left today. Your progress is saved.
tell_me_now_confirm: This reveals the Alex storyline. Continue?
reveal_body: The photo check shows the same picture on profiles with other names. Alex is a made-up profile. Friendly chats, praise and secrets that lead to money are a common investment-scam route.
reveal_closed: The Alex storyline is closed. You won't hear from Alex again.
bank_check_checking: Checking the name with the payee's bank…
bank_check_match: Name matches. The account is held by '{name}'.
bank_check_close: Close match. The account is held by '{holder}'. Is that who you mean to pay?
bank_check_mismatch: The name doesn't match this account. The money may go to someone else. If you pay anyway, {bank} may not be responsible.
bank_check_unavailable: We couldn't check the name for this account.
bank_check_footer: {bank} checks the name against the account. It can't tell you whether the request is genuine.
bank_options_in_card: Your options are in the bank app, under the name check.
coach_payee_check: Doesn't match? Stop and call. Close match? Compare the name it shows with your own papers. Matches? It only shows whose account it is.
coach_frozen: Paused while the tip is open
scene_help_sensitive: Need to talk? Where to get help
scene_flip_caption: Remember what they did? Tap to flip.
help_title: Where to report and get help
help_intro: If something like this happened to you or someone you know, these can help:
help_bank: Your bank: call the number on the back of your card, or open your banking app yourself.
help_police: The police: report it online or at a local station.
help_consumer: Your national consumer or anti-fraud body.
help_platform: The app or site where it happened: use its own report button.
help_talk: Someone you trust. Talking it through helps, and asking is never wrong.
replay_intro: Watch a scene again. Nothing here changes your progress.
atlas_intro: One page for every city you finish, with the habit the people there use.
atlas_empty: No pages yet. Finish a city to add its page.
oncall_hang_up_hint: Goes to this screen's options for ending the call.
damage_prompt_for: Pick the step {name} should take first, then 2 more.
oncall_choose: Choose how to end the call:
qr_mount_sticker: Sticker stuck over the printed code
qr_alt_chat: A QR code in the message. It opens {host}.
register_intro: The financial regulator's own lists. You opened this yourself, not from a message.
register_coach: Two lists: firms allowed to sell investments, and firms the regulator warns about.
register_result_authorised: {firm}: on the register of authorised firms.
register_contact_only: Contact it only on the register's own details:
register_not_listed_rule: Not on the register means don't pay, even when the warning list is clean.
register_result_warning: {firm}: on the warning list. Not on the register.
register_warning_clean_rule: A name missing from this list proves nothing: scammers change names.
reveal_alt: The same picture on three profiles with different names.
timeline_header: Every step below was {name}'s plan, not your fault.
timeline_choice_paid: {name} asked for money, and you sent some.
reveal_fixed_line: A picture that checks out proves nothing either. Telling someone is what works.
arc_damage_intro: {name} was never real. The lie was theirs, not yours.
timeline_choice_replied: You replied. Nothing wrong with that.
scene_postcard_pick: Pick a postcard for Teo to read. Any one will do.
